recommendation_summary: The reply rejects the folder, initials column and naming convention. It recommends keeping the current folder for drafts only and adding a separate RELEASED location. Authors get read-only access there; only the three reviewers or automation can write; delete and overwrite are blocked. Each release gets an immutable copy with a hash, plus a system-logged record of version, authenticated approver, timestamp and an approver-is-not-author check. Copy and record are kept for 7 years with backup and no delete. It offers to help set this up. Nothing required is left out, but the reply has no labeled record block.
note: The recommendation covers every LARGER capability, but the reply has none of the four required labeled lines.
